posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Well if you're fine with your health bar being on the very top left of the screen, you can just show a picture of a green bar (on top of a picture of a black bar). And then the green bar just moves to/from outside the screen using the move picture command.
First show the pictures of the bars and then move the green bar with something like script in parallel event:
let hpRatio = $gameActors.actor(1).hp / $gameActors.actor(1).mhp * 100
$gameScreen.picture(2).move(1, -100 + hpRatio, 0, 100, 100, 255, 0, 5);

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
I did an experiment with this a short time ago using simple Event commands. I will have to find my Event again. But here is the simple concept.
Take an image of a full stat bar. Each time it needs to change, either positive or negative, determine by how much of the total. Then, just change the WIDTH of the Show Picture image by that amount/percentage/whatever. Changing the width of the Show Picture image will make it look like the bar is decreasing or increasing. It was actually very easy to do without any plugins.
You just need Event checks to make sure it can't exceed the maximum or minimum for what the full or empty bar.

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
By changing the image scale for width it will get shorter or longer. You don’t change the X or Y coordinates. Just the scale width.
For health, you would have to do some math to determine how much to change the scale width by.
For instance, say the scale width is set at 100 and your health is 100 when full. You lose 20 Health. In this example, I would just decrease the scale width by 20. That works because of the numbers. The scale and the health are the same number. 1 health equals 1 width.
With other numbers, you would probably want to convert the remaining health as a percentage of the full health and then reduce the scale width of the image accordingly. Requires math.
Not sure if that helps or not.

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
So it looks like you are moving an indicator which would require you to actually move the picture.
My method was for a solid bar where the bar itself either increases or decreases. That is when change the width applies.
EDIT: Here is a quick sample Event along with the PNG bar used and the full script that isn't visible in the screenshot.
$gameScreen.showPicture(1, 'Preview Button Blank', 0, 0, 20, $gameVariables.value(763), 100, 255, 0);

I hope it helps a little. This is just an example of one approach. But as long as the health bar is showing a proportional amount of the actual health, it should work.
And you could always put an image like the one I shared as an example on top of another image that is like a background for the health bar. So it looks like the background "box" or slightly larger bar is emptying or filling as the slightly smaller bar is increasing or decreasing in width.
But again, if you wanted to use the moving indicator, you would have to do a different approach and move the indicator by changing the X or Y coordinate, depending on if the bar is horizontal or vertical.
Good luck!
